universal_lens: The system unifies high-dimensional sports analytics into a rigorous measure-theoretic framework. By mapping human-charted funnels to stochastic processes and enforcing Fréchet-Hoeffding copula bounds, the architecture guarantees mathematically consistent joint probabilities while dynamically adjusting for environmental priors and market regime shifts.

The engine evaluates second-and-one sneak traps and first-quarter script stops to optimize real-time situational decision-making against opposing defensive shell configurations.

primitives.name: Fréchet-Hoeffding SGP Joint Probability Bound
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Fréchet-Hoeffding SGP Bounds (`packages/prediction-engine/src/nfl/sgp-copula.ts`):** Enforces $P(A \cap B \cap C) \le 0.88 \cdot \min(p_1, p_2, p_3)$ on all 3-leg SGPs (`CAR @ GB` 3-leg SGP joint probability `0.2665`, fair odds `+275` vs market `+380`).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P: Joint probability of intersection (dimensionless). A, B, C: Event spaces for 3-leg Same Game Parlay. p_1, p_2, p_3: Marginal probabilities of individual legs (dimensionless). 0.88: Empirical correlation scaling factor (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Events are positively quadrant dependent; marginal probabilities are calibrated to true underlying frequencies rather than market-implied probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails when legs exhibit extreme negative correlation (e.g., mutually exclusive outcomes) or if the empirical scaling factor 0.88 is violated by unprecedented game flow anomalies.

layer2.telemetry: Discrepancy between calculated fair odds (+275) and market odds (+380).
